policy.score_semantics: No synthetic percentage or hidden weighted score is produced. The calculation exposes exact core-number pairs, exact-match flags, absolute numeric differences and an exact-match count.
policy.reduction_policy: Both profiles must use the same explicit Pythagorean reduction policy; mixed policies are rejected.
policy.interpretation_boundary: Human-readable relationship interpretation is separate CONTENT logic and cannot change the calculation result.

remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
TR/EN compatibility interpretation coverage must be proven separately if shown to users.
UI must disclose the compared numerology system and reduction policy rather than presenting a hidden universal compatibility percentage.
